# unifi_hotspot2_conf (Resource)

The `unifi_hotspot2_conf` resource manages a Passpoint / Hotspot 2.0 (Wi-Fi Alliance Online Sign-Up) configuration profile in the UniFi controller. The profile carries the ANQP, venue, roaming, NAI-realm, OSU and QoS-map parameters advertised to Passpoint-capable clients and can be attached to a WLAN.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A minimal Passpoint / Hotspot 2.0 configuration profile.
resource "unifi_hotspot2_conf" "example" {
  name = "example-passpoint"

  network_type = 2
  venue_group  = 2
  venue_type   = 8

  network_access_internet = true

  friendly_name = [
    {
      language = "eng"
      text     = "Example Venue"
    },
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `anqp_domain_id` (Number) The ANQP domain identifier (0–65535).
- `capab` (Attributes List) The ANQP IP-connectivity capability list (protocol/port reachability). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--capab))
- `cellular_network_list` (Attributes List) The 3GPP cellular network list advertised via ANQP. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cellular_network_list))
- `deauth_req_timeout` (Number) The number of seconds a client should wait before re-associating after a deauthentication request.
- `disable_dgaf` (Boolean) Whether to disable Downstream Group-Addressed Forwarding (DGAF).
- `domain_name_list` (List of String) The list of domain names advertised in the ANQP domain-name element.
- `friendly_name` (Attributes List) The operator friendly names, one per language. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--friendly_name))
- `gas_advanced` (Boolean) Whether advanced GAS configuration is enabled.
- `gas_comeback_delay` (Number) The GAS comeback delay, in TUs, advertised to clients.
- `gas_frag_limit` (Number) The GAS response fragmentation limit, in bytes.
- `hessid` (String) The homogeneous ESS identifier (HESSID), a MAC-formatted address, or empty.
- `hessid_used` (Boolean) Whether the homogeneous ESS identifier (HESSID) is advertised.
- `icons` (Attributes List) The operator icons advertised to clients. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--icons))
- `ipaddr_type_avail_v4` (Number) The advertised IPv4 address-type availability. One of `0`–`7`.
- `ipaddr_type_avail_v6` (Number) The advertised IPv6 address-type availability. One of `0`, `1` or `2`.
- `metrics_downlink_load` (Number) The advertised WAN downlink load, as a fraction of 255.
- `metrics_downlink_load_set` (Boolean) Whether the WAN downlink load value is set.
- `metrics_downlink_speed` (Number) The advertised WAN downlink speed, in kbps.
- `metrics_downlink_speed_set` (Boolean) Whether the WAN downlink speed value is set.
- `metrics_info_at_capacity` (Boolean) Whether the WAN link is advertised as being at capacity.
- `metrics_info_link_status` (String) The advertised WAN link status. One of `up`, `down` or `test`.
- `metrics_info_symmetric` (Boolean) Whether the WAN link is advertised as symmetric.
- `metrics_measurement` (Number) The WAN metrics measurement duration, in tenths of a second.
- `metrics_measurement_set` (Boolean) Whether the WAN metrics measurement value is set.
- `metrics_status` (Boolean) Whether WAN metrics advertisement is enabled.
- `metrics_uplink_load` (Number) The advertised WAN uplink load, as a fraction of 255.
- `metrics_uplink_load_set` (Boolean) Whether the WAN uplink load value is set.
- `metrics_uplink_speed` (Number) The advertised WAN uplink speed, in kbps.
- `metrics_uplink_speed_set` (Boolean) Whether the WAN uplink speed value is set.
- `nai_realm_list` (Attributes List) The NAI realm list advertised via ANQP. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nai_realm_list))
- `name` (String) The name of the Hotspot 2.0 configuration profile.
- `network_access_asra` (Boolean) Whether Additional Steps Required for Access (ASRA) is advertised.
- `network_access_esr` (Boolean) Whether Emergency Services Reachable (ESR) is advertised.
- `network_access_internet` (Boolean) Whether the network is advertised as providing internet access.
- `network_access_uesa` (Boolean) Whether Unauthenticated Emergency Service Accessible (UESA) is advertised.
- `network_auth_type` (Number) The network authentication type. One of `-1`, `0`, `1`, `2` or `3`.
- `network_auth_url` (String) The network authentication redirect URL.
- `network_type` (Number) The access-network type. One of `0`, `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `5`, `14` or `15`.
- `osu` (Attributes List) The Online Sign-Up (OSU) provider list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--osu))
- `osu_ssid` (String) The SSID used for Online Sign-Up (OSU).
- `qos_map_dcsp` (Attributes List) The QoS map DSCP range entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--qos_map_dcsp))
- `qos_map_exceptions` (Attributes List) The QoS map DSCP-to-user-priority exceptions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--qos_map_exceptions))
- `qos_map_status` (Boolean) Whether the QoS map is advertised.
- `roaming_consortium_list` (Attributes List) The roaming consortium organisation identifiers advertised via ANQP. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roaming_consortium_list))
- `save_timestamp` (String) The server-managed save timestamp of the profile.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.
- `t_c_filename` (String) The filename of the uploaded terms-and-conditions document.
- `t_c_timestamp` (Number) The terms-and-conditions file timestamp.
- `venue_group` (Number) The venue group. One of `0`–`11`.
- `venue_name` (Attributes List) The venue names, one per language. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--venue_name))
- `venue_type` (Number) The venue type within the venue group. One of `0`–`15`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# import from provider configured site
terraform import unifi_hotspot2_conf.example 5dc28e5e9106d105bdc87217

# import from another site
terraform import unifi_hotspot2_conf.example another-site:5dc28e5e9106d105bdc87217
```
